node.statement: Set e_pair=e_up and choose the universal C_pair>=max{C_np,K,4*C_np}. Nodes 1.1-1.2 make q_1,q_2 nonvanishing C_pair*epsilon_X-projections with q_1+q_2=I_X (enlarging the defect allowance preserves that property); nodes 1.3 and 1.8 give the required single linear map, its extended C_pair*epsilon_X-inclusion bounds at every amplification, the exact unit value, and the exact standard-basis images. Taking P'=q_1 and P''=q_2 proves every clause of the root contract.
